text: The owned nsIEwsServer to IExchangeOutgoingServer change keeps UUID 09f44948-e01d-40a7-af19-13dbb6ae1fb5 and initialize(AUTF8String); the parameter and comments gain Exchange/outgoing names. The unchanged Rust initializer parses the URL, sets it once and stores the EwsUrl preference. Build inputs and actual JS/Rust consumers move together. At the fixed accepted revision, the same interface name instead exposes exchangeUrl, whose setter still rejects another assignment. Keep that later API change separate from the rename. EWS and Graph use the shared outgoing implementation; protocol and stored preference names are not all renamed. This is static source support, not a compiled compatibility or send result.
